gen.title: Rebasing an index to a new base period
gen.orderNote: Follow the order used to rebase an index in the text.

steps.label: Recognize need for new base
steps.quote: It is sometimes necessary to use index values on a reference base that is not published.

steps.label: Note rate of change stays same
steps.quote: the only difference between series is the year we set to 100, the rate of change is exactly the same.

steps.label: Calculate each period relative
steps.quote: First, we must find the relative for each data point in the series by dividing it by the previous data point.

steps.label: Choose new reference period
steps.quote: we can select any period to set equal to 100 (the new base) and chain the relatives from that value

steps.label: Chain relatives to build series
steps.quote: by multiplying the previous month’s index value by the current month’s index relative.

steps.label: Review worked example in table
steps.quote: An example of this process is given in table 2.
